verses.1: As for what you wrote about it, it’s good that a woman doesn’t fall in love.
verses.2: And because of their promiscuity, each man took his own wife, and each woman took her own husband.
verses.3: The man gives back to the woman what she has given him; similarly, the woman gives back to the man what he has given her.
verses.4: The woman of the same body does not have authority over it; rather, it’s the man who has that authority. Similarly, the man of the same body also does not have authority over it; it’s the woman who has that authority.
verses.5: Do not neglect each other. If it is necessary, then arrange to pray together at the right time again, so that Satan cannot deceive you through your lack of prayer.
verses.6: I say this out of courtesy, not out of obligation.
verses.7: I want all people to be like me. But each person has a unique gift from God; one person may have one trait, while another may have another.
verses.8: I say to those who are virtuous and kind-hearted people, it would be good for them if they remained as I am.
verses.9: But if they do not agree to it, then they shall be married. After all, it’s necessary to marry or to have sex.
verses.10: But to those who are already married, I say this: it’s not me who is speaking, but the Lord. Women should not be separated from their husbands.
verses.11: And even if they are separated, it is better to arrange a proper arrangement for the man and his wife—and not to leave the man without a wife.
verses.12: To the rest, I say this myself, not as the master. If a brother has an adulterer, and she continues to live with him, then do not give her up to him.
verses.13: And if a woman has an unfaithful husband, and he continues to live with her, then she should not let him stay with her.
verses.14: For the wicked man will be sanctified among women, and the wicked woman will be sanctified among her brothers. Since your children are unholy, they are now holy.
verses.15: But if the wicked are divided, then let us also be divided. The brother or sister among those who are such will not be deceived in this matter. In fact, God has called us to peace.
verses.16: Do you know, woman, whether you will save the man? Or do you know, air, whether you will save the woman?
verses.17: If not each one as the Lord intended, then each one should be called by God’s name. Thus, I will also decide in all assemblies.
verses.18: Is he disqualified from being chosen? I won’t be influenced by that. Are there any calls for him in the backstage area? I won’t be disqualified from that either.
verses.19: Perturbation isn’t anything at all, and akrobystia also isn’t anything at all. It’s simply a violation of God’s commands.
verses.20: Each person who was called upon was chosen for this purpose.
verses.21: Have you been chosen as a slave? I do not want to discuss that with you. But even if you could become free, it’s better to use your freedom wisely.
verses.22: For he who is called a slave in the Lord is indeed a free slave of the Lord. Similarly, the one who is called a free slave is actually a slave of Christ.
verses.23: You were called to be honorable people; do not become slaves of men.
verses.24: Each of you who was chosen, brothers, should bring something from this with him to God.
verses.25: As for the issue of virgins, I don’t have any rules or regulations regarding them. However, I do have my own opinion: it is considered trustworthy to be under the authority of a master.
verses.26: I believe that this is a good thing, because it’s necessary due to the growing need for it. It’s good for people to have such a situation.
verses.27: Are you a woman? Then don’t try to find a solution. Be free from women. Don’t want a wife at all.
verses.28: And even if you marry her, it’s not wrong. And if the virgin becomes a wife, it’s also not wrong. But those who cause suffering to the body are evil people. I, on the other hand, will protect you from them.
verses.29: I say this, brothers, because time is fleeting. The rest, then, let those who have wives do as they wish, just like those who don’t have wives.
verses.30: And those who cry, as if they don’t cry at all; and those who laugh, as if they don’t laugh at all; and those who bid farewell, as if they never really leave.
verses.31: And those who treat the world as if it were not to be treated at all… For it is they who determine the nature of this world.
verses.32: I want you to be obedient to me. The faithful servant should please his master, so that he may please him.
verses.33: And he who has conquered the world, how can he please a woman?
verses.34: And they are also affected. Both the married woman and the virgin share in their husband’s role, so that they may be holy both in body and soul. But the married woman shares in worldly things, so as to please her husband.
verses.35: I say this in a manner that is agreeable to you. I don’t want to impose any burden on you. Instead, I want to do it in a way that is fair and respectful towards the lord.
verses.36: But if anyone thinks that it is wrong to violate the law regarding his virgin daughter, then he must do as she desires. He does not commit any sin; they have already married her.
verses.37: But those who have a lustful desire in their hearts, yet have no need for power or control over their own desires, will still remain virgins. They will act properly and maintain their virginity.
verses.38: So that both those who marry a virgin properly do it, and those who do not marry will also do it properly.
verses.39: A woman remains with her husband for as long as he lives. If the man goes to sleep, then she is free to choose whom she wants to marry, but only from her own husband.
verses.40: It’s better, in my opinion, if it remains like that. I think I have the spirit of God within me.
